ns2:section.sectionText: This will be a modified online course exploring traditional and experimental printmaking techniques for making prints at home with minimal space. This course is intended for first-year students in the School of Art+Design. Online section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or Art Undeclared or New Media or Studio Art or Art and Art History major(s).
